fieldDescriptions.is_disabled: Whether the job is currently disabled.
fieldDescriptions.revenue: Effective revenue: uses the task total when present, otherwise the job's manual value.
fieldDescriptions.billing_frequency: The billing cadence configured for the job.
fieldDescriptions.cost_to_date: The sum of hourly costs for all time entries logged against the job.
fieldDescriptions.budget_used_pct: The percentage of revenue consumed by cost to date; empty when revenue is not positive.
fieldDescriptions.hours_to_date: The total hours logged against the job.
fieldDescriptions.days_until_deadline: Calendar days from today to the end date; negative after the deadline.
fieldDescriptions.days_until_start: Calendar days from today to the start date; negative after work begins.
fieldDescriptions.days_since_start: Calendar days elapsed since the start date; negative before work begins.
fieldDescriptions.tasks_count: The total number of job tasks, including disabled tasks.
fieldDescriptions.enabled_tasks_count: The number of currently enabled job tasks.
fieldDescriptions.planned_effort_hours: The sum of planned effort hours across tasks.
fieldDescriptions.monthly_effort_hours: The sum of monthly effort hours configured across tasks.
fieldDescriptions.period_hours: Hours logged in the latest completed period after applying optional user and task filters.
fieldDescriptions.period_entry_count: The number of time entries in the latest completed period after applying optional filters.
fieldDescriptions.period_active_users: The number of distinct users with entries in the latest completed period.
fieldDescriptions.period_active_tasks: The number of distinct tasks used by entries in the latest completed period.
fieldDescriptions.period_cost: The cost of entries in the latest completed period after applying optional filters.
fieldDescriptions.billing_type: The effective billing type; mixed when tasks use different billing types.
fieldDescriptions.tipo_confirmed: Whether the job classification has been confirmed.
